steps.content: <size=31>She returns to the ground. Half of the ink goes into the ink bottle on her right arm, while the other half turns into the black raven that had come with you all this way. The tall woman strikes a graceful pose, and the bird lands gently on her uplifted hand.</size>

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: A perfect debut.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: It'd be even better if the audience would show some excitement.
She shuts her eyes to indulge in the moment. You stare at her with pursed lips, counting the seconds in your heart.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: A shy friend, I see. If you're too bashful for words, why not give me a round of applause?
Raven stays in the same pose until you finally clap a few times. She then opens her eyes with a smile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hello, Raven. I'm the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, a new friend of Rustfire, an old friend of Syndicate, the heartthrob of DisCity, and... <color=#fb9259>a Mania magnet wherever I go</color>.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My name is ${PlayerName}. I have no pen name. You can call me "Dear Chief."
Raven laughs, jots down everything in a small notebook, and applauds you dramatically.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Yes, perfect. Smile and relax, just like that. You look better when you smile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I had opened the envelope before I got here, you would've killed me with your "ink," right?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: My, still holding a grudge? I already told you, those were just some dramatic effects for my "debut."

options: Your outfit reminds me of someone...

steps.content: (Scene change)

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: Don't resist the orders, don't hinder the execution, or else...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You fit right in with the execs.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: It's part of a journalist's job to do undercover investigations. I've received special training in Eastside.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Don't worry. Right now, the Executive Committee only regards you as a fool who's ignorant of the rules, not an enemy. They don't dare touch you. After all, you've got the MBCC, FAC, and 9th Agency behind you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Looks like you investigated me as well.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Hehe, I'm a top-notch reporter. Getting the inside scoop, catching eyes, stirring things up and making them go viral—I can do it all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you a member of Rustfire, too?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Yes, but I have an office job. I don't like violence.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: <size=31>I go undercover to collect intelligence and make my mark on the battleground of public opinion. More importantly, I witness, record, and broadcast those magnificent feats to ignite hope in people's hearts and attract more like-minded companions.</size>

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: People often praise my radiant presence by calling me "grandiose."

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: If they are the fire upon the rust, then I am the wind that sweeps the land. My words can spark a raging wildfire.
"Regardless of creed or color, come fight for justice! The hero from the Bureau has joined our side! The architect Julien weeps with joy and faints on the operating table!"
You let out a sigh.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I thought journalists would focus on telling the truth.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Journalists are warriors, too. The truth is just one of the weapons we wield.

options: Then what do you fight for?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You fight injustice and fate like Rustfire? You also want to take back what was lost?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: No, I fight for love.
She suddenly edges close to you and stares into your eyes.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I love those who struggle in the dark. I love their souls that are torn by despair. I love their eyes that are awash with tears, and how they shine after suffering pain and torment.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Tragic, dramatic, and brimming with passion, they cling onto the faintest sliver of hope and plunge into the darkness. The fiery sparks of their dreams are but drops in the ocean, to be forever devoured by the darkness.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Yet this is precisely why that fleeting spark is so dazzling. I must witness and record everything up close, so as to immortalize their lives in my poetry.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: That's right. I'd rather be regarded as the "DisCity Poet" than a renowned journalist. My dream is for my poems to be read across this land for all eternity.
...Immortal poetry? She needs to work on her language skills, then.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Haha, you have the same look as Julien the first time I told him this. Most of the Rustfire folks had the same reaction. You'll get along just fine.
She suddenly squeezes your chin.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: But I actually looked forward to your arrival, dear Chief. Or should I say... I looked forward to the Shackler of Sinners, the Destroyer of Black Rings, and the Shepherd of DisCity.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Tell me what you've been up to. I've missed out on so many things lately.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Tell me about that riveting speech you gave in the Drifter Camp. Tell me what you were thinking when you almost died from that fall.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: How did you convince the Legion? And how did you face "Zoya's" wrath?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: What was on your mind during the chaos of the Carnival?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Tell me about your Sinners, your shackles, your superiors, and those who have died for you. Tell me about your lost memories and uncertain future.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: What kind of darkness have you witnessed? And why are you still here?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: What are you in pursuit of?
She edges closer to you as if she wanted to devour you alive.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Tell me. I will use every detail to craft the most authentic representation of you.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Many believe you can bring about change. They look up to your resolve and yearn for your guidance, and long for you to lead and enlighten them.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: If I use my pen and paper to craft you into a star, to an idol, I'd definitely be able to create a heroic epic! Those in the dark yearn for light and hope the most. They need a hero.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Will you be this hero? Become the object of my odes, and realize each other's dreams?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I didn't do it on purpose.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you're talking about what I said back at the Drifter Camp... I made that up to defeat the Corpseborne. Can I skip this one out?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You guys be the leaders. I have other things to do.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't need any odes. Nor do I want to get involved with plans I don't know about.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm here to get rid of the Black Ring, not to be forced into becoming some leader.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Hahaha! No problem! Remember these words, then. Play your role well.
She pats you on the cheek and leaves you.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: It really is hard for me to fight for you, write poems about you and make sure you don't die at the same time. But I have a better plan to realize my dreams.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: After I become famous in Eastside, I'll return to Syndicate and work with Rustfire to open a school upon the ruins that'll educate the next generation.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: That way, my poems can be passed down generation after generation through my students!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I've got my eyes on those two little Sinners of yours. Children shouldn't be on the battlefield. Why not send them to be educated at my school?

options: I think it's better if you hired other teachers...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Please spare Syndicate's children.
Raven is already immersed in her own fantasies.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: No worries. You fight your Black Ring, and I'll write my poems. We'll each live our best lives.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: In any case, the ensuing battle will be a much-needed ray of light for this dark era. Grave perils, dark secrets, and even a turning point in history... plus you, an interesting soul.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
She gleefully takes a comb out of nowhere and starts changing up your hairstyle. You feel a bit dizzy from all the combing.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: By the way, since we have some time to chat, I want to tell you that I sold those two kids of yours.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: I'm just joking.
She suddenly aims a camera at you. Snap—the flash blinds your eyes.
The picture prints out quickly. She shakes it and takes a look, apparently satisfied.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: This one's not bad. Your gaze looks sharp, and shows your fighting spirit.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: We leave in half an hour. I'll go prepare the mobilization. Apart from the elite few who will go down into the mine with you, the people waiting above also need some reassuring.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Don't worry. With my writing skills, I'll be sure to paint a glowing picture of you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What are you going to write?

steps.content: You find out for yourself soon enough. It doesn't take long for everyone to get their hands on identical leaflets hot off the press.

steps.speaker: Raven's Leaflet
steps.content:
The darkness of West District rears its head again!
The mysterious force that destroyed the Legion and nourished the gangs appears in the Drifter Camp.
Why is the Executive Committee ignoring it?

Was the Legion really destroyed? Or did they just go into hiding?
Exclusive reveal! The Drifter Camp's mysterious savior is actually Legion Captain Zoya's...
You feel everyone's burning gaze on you.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Rustfire's propaganda style is a bit dramatic, and sometimes... stretches the truth. This is just to catch people's eyes. To win people over, we have to be seen first.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Uncover the truth, then use it to mobilize the public. See how excited everyone is?

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: By the way, do you want to call Julien? He should be awake from his surgery by now.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Even though communications are cut off in Inner Bay, I can use my ink raven for long-distance communication. You two leaders can mobilize together.
You rip the leaflet in your hands to shreds, and also confiscate the ones in Hecate and Hella's hands. Raven laughs and waves behind her.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Everyone, next up is the battle for BR-002! The future of Syndicate is here!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: All right! This is the fateful place where our hopes, glories, and comrades-in-arms are buried. West District might crumble, but even if we are buried, forgotten, and reduced to dust, we will never truly die.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Go take back our mines, take back West District's Hypercubes, and everything else that rightfully belongs to us, including the future!

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Eight years ago, the fire snuffed out here. 8 years later, this is where the fire shall be rekindled!
Her passionate proclamations echo throughout the mines, stirring up the crowd's fighting spirit...
